summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus supplement for the issuance of $905,038,000 Class A Pass Through Certificates, Series 2026-1A, by American Airlines, Inc. to finance 32 aircraft (Boeing 737 MAX 8, Airbus A321 XLR, A321-200, and Boeing 777-300ER). The certificates are secured by equipment notes and involve a pass-through trust structure with semiannual interest payments. Natixis provides a liquidity facility. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event. The filing is a standard capital markets transaction to fund aircraft purchases.
